scope: WP2 resource boundary: lease/controlEpoch, side-effect tri-state, idempotent CAS guard, memory adapter, boundary invariant
limitations: Memory adapter only: no Durable persistence, crash recovery or multi-process safety
No real browser/file/notification/network adapter; no HTTP error mapping
Crash window simulated by commit failure; no real SIGKILL for resource state
Concurrency is single-process event-loop CAS plus wrapper-store reordering, not multi-process load
Custom fingerprint injection and performance/long-run not measured
Residual window between attempt commit and effect.invoke is documented; real adapter must re-check control epoch
